review_method: Read every source record's description, license hint, stars, and updatedAt; directly reviewed the source README/license/package or module for the candidate data-plane tools and recorded the boundary that prevents admission.

candidates.description: Rust functions that generate SQL for PostgreSQL tables, views, materialized views, functions, triggers, and indexes

The record has an Other license and no description, so capability, provenance, and reuse terms are unverified.

candidates.description: Lightweight, agent-optimized database CLI with one-shot schema introspection, column profiling, and ERD generation

candidates.description: Dynamic parameter-argument validation for PHP with rich type constraints, attributes, and schema introspection
candidates.reason: The record is an Apache-2.0 PHP parameter validation library, not a database read adapter; it may inform input contracts but does not fit the host boundary.

candidates.description: Agent-first Asana CLI with schema introspection
candidates.reason: The record describes Asana API introspection, not client Postgres schema/read-model introspection; it is outside this cluster's adapter boundary.

candidates.description: Parse the JSON of full schema introspection to a readable type system

candidates.description: PostgreSQL schema introspection, diff, DDL generation, and safe migration execution
candidates.reason: Direct pinned LICENSE is Business Source License 1.1: development/testing/evaluation are free but production use requires a commercial license. That is outside the current MIT/Apache/BSD/ISC v0 OSS reuse path, so it is rejected for client block reuse and retained only as reference.
